definitions.explanation: Not taking sides in a dispute or conflict. Used in political, diplomatic, and everyday contexts to describe an impartial stance.

examples.japanese: {中立|ちゅうりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中立|ちゅうりつ}で⟦いたい→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I want to remain neutral on this issue.

examples.japanese: スイス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{永世|えいせい}{中立|ちゅうりつ}{国|こく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}って→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧きた。
examples.english: Switzerland has maintained its status as a permanently neutral country throughout its long history.

notes:
{中立|ちゅうりつ} means staying impartial and not favoring either side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中立|ちゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (maintain neutrality)
- {中立|ちゅうりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (neutral stance)
- {中立|ちゅうりつ}{国|こく} (neutral country)
- {永世|えいせい}{中立|ちゅうりつ}{国|こく} (permanently neutral country)
- {中立|ちゅうりつ}{的|てき} (neutral, impartial — used as a na-adjective modifier)

Sometimes used critically to suggest someone is avoiding responsibility by not taking a clear position.
